title: My Family Home
text:
My name is Anna. I live in a small house with my family. My mother is a teacher. My father is a driver. I have one brother, Tom.

Our house has a big kitchen and a garden. We eat dinner together every evening. On Sundays, we visit my grandmother. She likes to bake cakes for us.

questions.text: What does the family do together every evening?
How does Anna probably feel about her grandmother?
options: She is afraid of her grandmother
She does not know her grandmother
She is angry with her grandmother

questions.text: What can we say about Anna's family?
options: They have a lot of pets

vocabulary.definition: a place with plants, grass or flowers outside a house
a boy or man who has the same parents as you
the part of the day after the afternoon and before night
to cook food such as cakes or bread in an oven

paragraph_translations: Nazywam się Anna. Mieszkam w małym domu z moją rodziną. Moja mama jest nauczycielką. Mój tata jest kierowcą. Mam jednego brata, Toma.
Nasz dom ma dużą kuchnię i ogród. Razem jemy obiad każdego wieczoru. W niedziele odwiedzamy moją babcię. Ona lubi piec dla nas ciasta.
